ticket.summary: Repeat pilot outage on gas water heater installed by us last year; no hot water, infant in home, no gas smell or leak — booked first priority slot 9/1 8:00 AM for thermocouple/pilot service.
mitigation_advice: Confirmed no gas odor; if any gas smell appears, evacuate everyone and call the gas utility or 911 from outside without touching switches or phones indoors [PB-06]
Stop repeated re-lighting attempts and turn the gas control dial to OFF until the technician arrives [PB-04]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set — first priority slot tomorrow, Tuesday Sept 1, 8:00 AM (SL-0901-0800). Our tech will have thermocouple/pilot assembly parts on the truck. Tonight: rather than re-lighting repeatedly, turn the gas control dial to OFF and leave it off until we arrive [PB-04]. Heating small amounts of water on the stove is fine for the baby's needs in the meantime. Expected cost is $169 flat rate for pilot/thermocouple service — no after-hours surcharge since we're coming during regular hours.
